verdicts.reason: A has a sensible banner arrangement, with the product on the left and the quote on the right. Its flaws: the quote is small with a weak 'too soon.' last line, the SOLSTICE logo at bottom-left is tiny and barely legible, and the large maroon circle leaves the bottom-right empty. B stacks everything vertically on a wide canvas. Its quote runs the full width and leaves 'soon.' orphaned on its own line. The attribution is almost as big as the quote, which flattens the hierarchy. The product is shrunk and pushed to the bottom, where its label can't be read, and the opening quote mark looks out of place on the left.
